title: My Pipeline: choose the structure
question: Three ways to make the backlog the job, with live deals in one list by what's next. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Ahead and Never recorded
options.lineage: Today's departures board, applied to the whole book
options.thesis: Two lanes: what's ahead in time order, and the calls never recorded, oldest first, cleared in place.
options.viewport: Title row with month switcher, the money strip, then side by side: AHEAD on navy (calls, call-backs, links in time order with status words) and a white NEVER RECORDED · 298 card, oldest first, each row with No-show, Lost and Open; All deals collapsed below.
options.risk: Two lists side by side get narrow on a laptop next to Zoom; the backlog card must fold its row actions well.

raised.raise: Both lanes share one fixed column grid; a row's state restyles in place and never jumps.
A cleared call stays in its row stamped NO-SHOW or LOST until the page reloads, so the closer sees the work done.
The oldest unrecorded call heads its lane with its choices ahead of it.

options.label: The runway
options.lineage: A time axis of the book, past to future
options.thesis: One strip shows every open deal on a week axis: unrecorded calls behind today, scheduled steps ahead; pick a stretch and the list below follows.
options.viewport: Title and money line, then a navy runway: 16 weeks of stacked bars (amber behind today, blue ahead) with TODAY marked; under it one list scoped to the selected weeks, oldest unrecorded first, inline No-show and Lost.
options.risk: The chart is new vocabulary on a working page; it must stay a filter, not a report.

options.label: The clearing desk
options.lineage: The task queue: a list beside one open record
options.thesis: A queue of unrecorded calls on the left, one open on the right with its outcome question; record it and the next one opens.
options.viewport: Band with tabs NEVER RECORDED 298 · AHEAD 14 · ALL DEALS and the month's money; a 340px queue oldest first; the open call as a board strip with the outcome panel 'Did Alice C show up on Jul 14?' and No-show, Held, Lost; J and K move.
options.risk: Strong for clearing, weaker for a glance at the month; live deals sit one tab away.
